name: Do I need shoe molding or quarter round with my basement baseboards?

mainEntity.name: Do I need shoe molding or quarter round with my basement baseboards?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding base shoe or quarter round is recommended for finished basements, especially over hard surfaces like luxury vinyl plank, laminate, or tile. Basement concrete slabs frequently have dips and high spots that leave small gaps beneath rigid baseboards. Rather than forcing down the main baseboard and distorting clean corner miters, carpenters add flexible shoe molding. Shoe molding bends smoothly to trace the floor line, concealing gaps and covering the expansion space required along flooring edges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Shoe molding is highly recommended in basements because it flexes over uneven concrete subfloors and covers necessary flooring expansion gaps.
